Hence every position derivative of a line Ward test is again a finite sum of line Ward tests for successor- degree labels. The all-order scaling comparison (WS7) transports these tests to the free quotient, where the translation and angular actions are explicit derivatives of polynomials. Finitely many separated reading maps suffice at each finite degree, by the detector argument in (WS4)–(WS5). Their matrices converge to injective free matrices. This transfers the free rank statements for the spaces of possible internal defects and forces any such defect to vanish. Thus the translation shell map is one positive scalar c times the already constructed derivative, and the angular rows, divided by c, satisfy the Ward identity at every separated tuple.
